title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 71: Career choices (Set 2)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Career choices (Set 2) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Career choices (Set 2)
vocabTable.example: Read the conversation and then choose the correct answer to fill in each blank. David: I want to 14.1 abandon pursue  a career in teaching, but I’m not sure if I can handle it. Anna: Teaching requires being 14.2 brave calm , especially when students are not paying attention. David: That sounds difficult. Maybe I 14.3 overestimated respected myself and in fact, I am not suitable for this job. Anna: You're good enough to become a teacher, David. With time, you will learn how to be more 14.4 violent patient  with your students, and things will improve. Don't worry! David: I really want to help students learn. I just worry about the challenges. Anna: If you stay focused and keep learning, you will 14.5 measure achieve success. Just keep trying! I believe you can do that. David: Thanks for your words, Anna. I'm now more confident in myself.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Career choices (Set 2)
vocabTable.example: Reorder the letters to make complete words. The first letters are underlined. Tom: I’m thinking about my career 13.1 (T- P -H-A) , but I’m not sure which one to choose. Lily: You should consider what interests you most. Some jobs have a high 13.2 (R-A-A-L- S -Y) . Tom: I’ve heard that doctors and engineers are 13.3 (P-E-A-L-I-L-D- W ) , but their work sounds really 13.4 (M-D- D -E-N-N-I-A-G) . Lily: Yes, it can be tough, but if you enjoy the field, it can be worth it. Tom: I agree. I’m interested in technology, so maybe being a software developer is a good choice. Lily: That sounds like a great idea!

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Career choices (Set 2)
vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the passage. If you want to become a doctor or surgeon, you need to start with the right education. Many people begin by enrolling in a 15.1 , where they learn about the human body and how to treat different diseases. After finishing their basic studies, some choose to join 15.2 that focus on specific skills. Surgeons work with a 15.3 . It includes doctors, nurses, and other specialists who help during surgeries. Good 15.4  is important because surgeons need to carefully control their tools while performing delicate operations. Choosing a career in medicine is a big decision, but with the right training and skills, you can make a difference in people’s lives. It’s a challenging but rewarding job that requires a lot of dedication and hard work.
